title: The months
description: Name the months, and say when something happens.
grammar: the names of the months, without an article
grammarNote: A month takes no article: en enero, el 5 de enero, not el enero.

explanation.summary: The months are the one set of nouns in Spanish that never takes an article, and there are twelve of them, so this unit does the first ten.

sections.heading: The months
sections.body: Enero, febrero, marzo, abril, mayo, junio, julio, agosto, septiembre and octubre. All of them are masculine, but you never use the article with them: en mayo, en octubre. When you give the day as well, the day comes first and de follows: el 5 de mayo.

sections.heading: The two short ones
sections.body: Mayo and junio are the short months, and the -o of mayo drops when you add something to it: el primero de mayo, the first of May. The others keep their -o: el 3 de marzo, el 12 de octubre.

items.note: No article: en mayo. The -o drops before another word: el primero de mayo.
No article: en junio. The -o drops too: el primero de junio.
No article: en septiembre. It is also setiembre in Spain.

drills.note: A month never takes an article.
The day comes first, then de, then the month.
